notes: Nill Download Manager 2.1.0 rebuilds the app's interface as true native windows — raw Win32 on Windows, GTK on Linux — over the same engine, download journal and browser-extension protocol, so nothing about downloading changes and everything in 2.0.10 is included. With no web engine in between, the app starts and responds faster. On Windows the installer no longer fetches and installs the WebView2 runtime, so setup is smaller and works fully offline, while the app-local runtime libraries it still needs are unchanged; on Linux the package drops the WebKit stack entirely. The per-download progress dialog is now a real native dialog on both systems, in the established shape — live percentage and filename in the title, Download status, Speed Limiter and Options on completion tabs, and the per-connection strip and table. The .ndm.lock cleanup also completes what 2.0.10 began: a finished download's lock file is now removed the moment the download finishes, rather than at the next launch. 2.1.0 is a required update for older versions.
